items.title: npm Staged Publishing Available, Adding a Human Approval Step before Packages Go Live
items.blurb: npm has introduced staged publishing for Node.js, requiring maintainer approval before a version is installable. Versions are queued and must pass a two-factor authentication challenge for release.
